mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_platform_model_create_receipts(request_id,actor_ref,request_fingerprint) VALUES(CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid),#{actor},#{fingerprint}) ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_platform_model_create_receipts SET model_id=CAST(#{modelId} AS bigint) WHERE request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid) AND model_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT actor_ref,request_fingerprint AS fingerprint,model_id::text AS model_id FROM nw_platform_model_create_receipts WHERE request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid)
